episodes.title: I Remember When (Haunted History): Brother XII
episodes.description:
Haunted History: Brother XII Cult || Canadians get culty, too.

#nostalgia #haunted #brothertwelve #cults #canadianhistory

Description: Brother XII, born Edward Arther Wilson, founded the Aquarian Foundation cult in 1927 on Vancouver Island. He amassed a following of 8,000, promising a utopian society and predicting the end of the current social order. However, his tyrannical rule, embezzlement, and use of black magic led to his downfall, and he fled to Europe with his mistress, Madame Zee, in 1932.
